sloka: भरत: प्रत्युवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिस्तं तपोधनम् ।ससैन्यो नोपयातो ऽस्मि भगवन् भगवद्भयात् ॥ २.९१.६॥
transliteration: bharata: pratyuvācedaṁ prāñjalistaṁ tapodhanam ।sasainyo nopayāto 'smi bhagavan bhagavadbhayāt ॥ 2.91.6॥

translations.english: With folded palms (in reverence), Bharata said to sage Bharadwaja whose penance was his wealth: I did not approach you with the army for fear of you, O venerable one.
